shortDescription: Creates, updates or deletes Remote Block Storage volume.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Endpoint to use to connect to API. Do not change until specifically asked to do otherwise. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_URL) environment variable is used.

options.name: flavor_id
options.description: Identifier of the flavor (mutually exclusive with I(flavor_name)). This or flavor_name should be provided to create a new volume.

options.name: flavor_name
options.description: Name of the flavor (mutually exclusive with I(flavor_id)). This or flavor_id should be provided to create a new volume.

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels to attach to the volume. If labels do not exist they will be created. Replaces existing set of labels with provided one if labels exist. Key-value pairs. If omitted, existing labels will remain unchanged. To remove all labels, set to an empty dict. More info at https://developers.servers.com/api-documentation/v1/#section/Labels.

options.name: location_code
options.description: Human-readable location slug (mutually exclusive with I(location_id)). This or location_id should be provided to create a new volume.

options.name: location_id
options.description: Location identifier. (mutually exclusive with I(location_name)). This or location_code should be provided to create a new volume.

options.name: size
options.description: Size of the volume in GB. Should be provided to create a new volume or increase size of existing one.

options.name: state
options.description:
State of the volume. Use C(present) to create or update a volume.
Only name, size and labels can be updated.
 Use C(absent) to delete a volume.

options.name: token
options.description: Token to use. You can create token for your account in https://portal.servers.com in Profile -> Public API section. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) or C(SC_TOKEN) environment variable is used (C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) takes precedence). Value is not logged.

options.name: update_interval
options.description: Interval in seconds between status checks.

options.name: volume_id
options.description: Volume identifier. If volume with specified volume_id does not exist, module will fail.

options.name: wait
options.description:
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the volume to reach
the desired state after an action (e.g. deletion).
Set to 0 to not wait.
